findings.title: Alternative publication veto can return success without any commit

evidence.detail: The guarded callback awaits work, then vetoes at lines 149 and 153-156 using {...result, commit:false}, preserving work's success value.
A callback with commit:false becomes status:preview with the unchanged callback value when request, actor and target remain authorized.
Inner work returns {status:ok,value:record}; mutate returns saved.value immediately for preview, before the post-commit read.

reproduction: Start an authorized native AlternativeDraft run with a valid private capture; keep the UI/request actor and target authorization unchanged.
After run-store's inner callback validates and stages ready/output/provenance, revoke the native binding or invalidate its provider generation before the wrapper's captureCurrent check.
The wrapper rejects commit, preserving {status:ok,value:readyRecord}; C08 wraps it as preview and run-store.publish returns ok.
Observe that persisted run remains running and output/provenance are absent although publish returned ready success.
findings.reproduction_kind: deterministic source trace; not a local product execution
findings.impact: Breaks C11 publication semantics and reports completed output without durable run/output/provenance. Generic request abort is separately caught by C08; the discriminating counterexample retains UI authorization while invalidating the native capture.
findings.minimum_fix: On every publication-wrapper veto, return a non-success discriminated value (or remove a success value so the store reports stale). Never propagate the inner success through commit:false. Preserve atomic staging and the final nativePublicationGuard.
findings.required_recheck: Hosted real run-store plus C08 wrapper test for native binding/generation invalidation after inner staging; expect non-ok publish and zero changes to run, contribution and provenance. Recheck the immutable replacement SHA.
findings.controller_triage: Accepted mandatory owned correction; not fixed or rechecked by R3.

findings.title: Preparation that cannot attach leaks host-owned run resources after revocation or abort

evidence.detail: Successful host.prepare is followed by attach; attach failure only calls host.interrupt. Active ownership is inserted later at 84-85; an announcement failure removes it before attempting interrupt.
interrupt requires current authority and returns denied on aborted/expired/revoked requests without invoking release; release is the host-owned cleanup operation.
withRunContext rejects an aborted request; background cleanup delegates to execution.releaseRun.
releaseRun returns immediately when no active entry exists, so it cannot clean a run which never attached or whose entry was removed.

reproduction: Allow host.prepare to succeed and retain its native binding, token ticket and skill observation.
Abort the original request or revoke its authority before the subsequent withRunContext/attach completes.
attach returns denied; host.interrupt also returns denied because the original authority is no longer current.

The execution was never added to active. Outer releaseRun is a no-op; host observations/runs/binding/token-ticket remain retained until global host disposal. Repeat canceled admissions to accumulate retained requests and resources.
findings.reproduction_kind: deterministic source trace; not a local product execution
findings.impact: Violates deterministic lifecycle cleanup and retains Request/admission resources beyond a rejected run. Existing authority checks still deny data/model execution after abort; this finding does not assert an authorization bypass.
findings.minimum_fix: Establish unconditional host.release ownership for every prepare-ok result until an active ticket successfully assumes ownership. Use a finalizer/try-finally so attach exceptions, denied attach and announcement failure all clean up independently of business authorization.
findings.required_recheck: Hosted counterexamples for abort and revocation between prepare and attach, thrown attach and throwing admission callback; verify no remaining binding, budget ticket or skill observation. Preserve unrelated Session execution and the global disposal test.
findings.controller_triage: Accepted mandatory owned correction; not fixed or rechecked by R3.

Prepare/run/read follows the explicit native-routine-*-unavailable branch; a fixture port is not native qualification.

WP09/WP10 then compose that real adapter. Do not fabricate assistant task messages or substitute SessionV2.resume.
